meaning.zh:
“我心意已决” 或 “我的心已定”。

这个短语源于情感和决心的表达，字面意思是 “我的心已经选定了（某物或某事）”。当你说 "My heart is set on" 某物时，表示你非常想要或渴望某物，以及你已确定自己的选择。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the expression of emotions and determination. Literally, it means "my heart has chosen (something)". When you say "My heart is set on" something, it indicates that you deeply want or desire it, and that you have made up your mind about your choice.

lines.en: My heart is set on going to Paris for vacation this year.
lines.zh: 我心意已决，今年要去巴黎度假。

lines.en: She knew her heart was set on becoming a doctor from a young age.
lines.zh: 她从小就知道自己心意已决，要成为一名医生。

lines.en: No matter what, my heart is set on this house; I can't imagine living anywhere else.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我心已定要这栋房子；我无法想象住在其他地方。
